
DESCRIPTION
Load environment variables and run a command

USAGE
  one exec [project] [-p <name|path>] [--env-provider dotenv|infisical] [--env <name>] -- <cmd> [args...]

TIPS
Loads project environment variables and runs a command in the project directory. Select a project by name or relative path, or run from inside a project. The positional project and --project must agree when both are used.

Use -- to separate One options from the child command. --env overrides the workspace default environment; --env-provider selects dotenv or Infisical. Loaded values override existing shell environment variables.

With --global, provide --env and --path explicitly. The command keeps the current working directory. Use --keys to select which shared credentials to inject.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Print the execution plan without loading environment values or starting a command
  --env <value>            Environment name (default: manifest.environments.default)
  --env-provider <value>   Environment source: dotenv or infisical (default: workspace configuration)
  --global                 Use shared credentials, keeping the current working directory
  --keys <value>           Inject only the specified variable names, separated by commas
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --path <value>           Shared credential folder (must be explicit)
  -p, --project <value>    Project name or relative path; inferred from the current directory by default
